exposure: use of bi-level noninvasive positive pressure ventilation
outcome: enteral nutrition initiation within 24 hours of admission
time to goal enteral nutrition rate
adequacy of nutrition (calorie and protein intake)
adverse events (pneumonia, intubation, feeding tube misplacement)
lengths of noninvasive positive pressure ventilation
cohort: The study included PICU patients older than 30 days requiring noninvasive positive pressure ventilation for greater than or equal to 24 hours from August 2014 to June 2015.
finding: A majority (64%) of critically ill children requiring noninvasive positive pressure ventilation received enteral nutrition within 24 hours of admission, but less than half achieved caloric and protein goals during their PICU stay.
